description:
Another word for amazing: 10 better English words, with pictures and examples. If you are looking for other ways to say amazing, you get five words for everyday conversation and five stronger words for writing and for work. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:14 Everyday conversation
1:11 Speaking practice: everyday conversation
1:41 Stronger words
2:39 Speaking practice: stronger words
3:12 Your turn

The 10 words
Everyday conversation: awesome, incredible, fantastic, wonderful, brilliant
Stronger words: remarkable, outstanding, extraordinary, spectacular, breathtaking

Which word will you use next time? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
